card.name: The word medical before history
card.fires_on: The word "medical" right after "Careful" in the C. difficile (CDAD) warning, where "history" is expected next.

modes.label: Careful medical history
modes.description: The word "medical" in the phrase "Careful medical history is necessary" in the CDAD diarrhea warning after antibiotic use.
modes.example: CDAD must be considered in all patients who present with diarrhea following antibiotic use. Careful<< medical>> history is necessary since CDAD has been

card.writes: It promotes the word "history" in its several spellings as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on "medical" when the next word is almost certainly "history", as in "careful medical history".
